agent_types.DecisionMaker: Agent responsible for processing information and making decisions based on defined criteria and objectives.
agent_types.EnvironmentMonitor: Agent tasked with observing and gathering data from the environment, providing real-time updates on system status.
agent_types.Communicator: Agent designed to facilitate interactions and information exchange between different agents within the system.
agent_types.TaskExecutor: Agent focused on carrying out specific tasks as assigned, ensuring objectives are met efficiently within set parameters.
